title: Borrow Stack Data in Threads
goal: Refactor thread spawning to borrow local slices instead of requiring static ownership.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Scoped Threads

hints: Standard `thread::spawn` requires 'static closures, which cannot borrow local variables from sum_halves.
Use `thread::scope` to create a scope context s, then call s.spawn to borrow stack variables.
explanation: `thread::scope` guarantees that all child threads finish before the function exits. Calling s.spawn on the scope handle allows threads to borrow local variables like left without taking ownership. Plain `thread::spawn` fails with E0373 because it requires captured references to be 'static.
